verdict.rationale: Online filing through a USCIS account is documented, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence publishes operating hours, per-day limits, or session timeouts for the online filing flow. The office-closure notice covers physical office visits, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
